lost.title: Lost connection to ReactCraft
lost.body: Trying to reconnect. You can keep working once the connection is back.

noProject.title: No project is open
noProject.body: ReactCraft opens the project in the folder where you started it. This folder has no ReactCraft project yet (.reactcraft/workspace.json).

projectError.title: Cannot open the project
projectError.oldVersion: This project was saved by an older ReactCraft that kept the design in JSON files. That format is no longer read.
projectError.howToFix: ReactCraft never overwrites .reactcraft/workspace.json. Fix or remove the file, then start ReactCraft again.

editor.canvasPending: The Canvas will show your project running here, from its own dev server.
editor.toggleLeft: Show or hide the left panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.toggleRight: Show or hide the right panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.layersHint: The structure of the page shows here once the Canvas runs your project.
editor.selectHint: Select an element on the Canvas to edit its Tailwind classes here.
editor.restricted: Restricted mode: nothing of this project runs

narrow.title: The Studio needs a screen at least 1024 px wide
narrow.body: Open it on a computer or widen the browser window. Your source code is not affected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Changes at once, without reloading. Remembered for every project on this computer.
settings.editorHelp: "Open in editor" jumps to the file and line of the selected element in this editor.
settings.packageManagerHelp: Installs the dependencies of a project ReactCraft creates. An existing project keeps its own.

trust.bar: This project is not trusted: its dev server, dependency installs and AI agents do not run. You can still look around.
trust.title: Do you trust this project?
trust.intro: Running a project runs its own code: the Vite configuration, its plugins and its dependencies. Trust only projects you know.
trust.restricted: Until you trust it, ReactCraft does not start its dev server, install its dependencies or run an AI agent on it.
